concerns.text: SC-001 (measure average alignment‑score difference between graph‑augmented and baseline on the conflicting subset) is not explicitly addressed; the plan only mentions running a paired test but does not state that the mean difference will be computed and reported.

SC-005 (robustness validation requiring no statistically significant drop in effect size between primary and hold‑out sets) is not mentioned; the plan includes a hold‑out robustness check but does not specify measuring effect‑size consistency or a p ≥ 0.05 criterion for the drop.
